faqs.question: How can students join the E-Cell team?
faqs.answer: We recruit new members at the beginning of each semester. Watch for announcements on our social media channels or visit the "Join Us" page for application details.

faqs.question: Can non-BITS students participate in E-Cell events?
faqs.answer: Yes, most of our events are open to students from all universities. However, some competitions may have specific eligibility criteria, which will be mentioned in the event details.

faqs.question: How can I get mentorship for my startup idea?
faqs.answer: Fill out our contact form selecting "Mentorship Opportunity" or email us at incubator@ecellbitspilanidubai.com with details about your idea and the specific guidance you're seeking.

faqs.question: Does E-Cell provide funding for student startups?
faqs.answer: While we don't directly fund startups, we connect promising ventures with potential investors and organize pitch competitions where you can win seed funding.

faqs.question: How can my company sponsor an E-Cell event?
faqs.answer: Please contact our partnerships team at partnerships@ecellbitspilanidubai.com with your proposal or use our contact form selecting "Sponsorship Inquiry".

faqs.question: Can E-Cell organize workshops for specific student groups?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can arrange customized workshops on entrepreneurship, innovation, and business skills. Send your request via the contact form or email events@ecellbitspilanidubai.com.
